title: Jorrybell Agoto’s family seeks gov’t aid amid ‘Filipiñana’ actress’ cancer battle

blocks.text: The family of “Filipiñana” star Jorrybell Agoto has appealed to government officials for financial assistance as she remains in critical condition while battling lymphoma, a type of cancer. In a recent social media post, Agoto’s sibling Jed asked for help from President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr., Sen. Imee Marcos, and Ilocos Norte 1st District Rep. Sandro Marcos, noting that the actress and the three officials hail from Sarrat, Ilocos Norte. “Sir PBBM, Ma’am Imee, at Cong. Sandro, kapwa anak po ng Sarrat ang kapatid ko. Sobrang proud kami sa kanya kasi siya yung bida sa ‘Filipiñana,’ yung official entry ng Pilipinas […]...
